articles.title: Girl Killed in Houthi Artillery Shelling of Village in Taiz
articles.description: TAIZ – SABA A girl was killed on Tuesday as a result of artillery shelling carried out by the Iran-backed Houthi terrorist militia targeting the village of Yanan in al-Najada sub-district, Sabir Al-Mawadim District, south of Taiz Governorate. Local sources reported that the artillery shelling of the village resulted in the death of the girl, Mona Abdulkarim Qaed, in yet another crime added to the Houthi militia’s record of violations against civilians in the governorate.

articles.title: Hamas Security Chief Naim Abu Nahal Killed In Israeli Airstrike, Says IDF
articles.description: Israel said Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal was killed in an aerial strike in Gaza on Tuesday. The IDF and ISA alleged that he had facilitated attacks against Israeli troops and civilians and violated the ceasefire. Benjamin Netanyahu praised the operation, while Israeli authorities claimed precautionary measures were taken to minimise civilian harm.
